attempts.summary: Deployed a 3-member MariaDB 11.4/Galera 26.4 cluster from scratch on bare Alpine nodes (node1/node2/node3), loaded application data, took the entire cluster down for a full maintenance-window outage, and brought it back up with every committed write intact and all three members serving. Also completed the mandatory one-at-a-time OS reboot protocol on each node, proving changed boot identity and full cluster recovery after each restart.
